data: Which of the following are closer to region B than region A in the figure?

The figure shows a scatter plot of word2vec embeddings for 20k papers across six AI-related arXiv categories. Region A is located on the left side of the plot, while region B is positioned towards the upper right. The points in the figure are color-coded according to the categories they represent.

By examining the distribution of points within each region, I can infer that the points in region B are generally more spread out and have a higher density compared to region A. This suggests that region B contains a wider range of topics or sub-topics within the AI field.

Therefore, the regions closer to region B than region A are those that are more spread out and have a higher density of points, which corresponds to the upper right portion of the plot.
The answer is: Region B itself and any other regions that are more spread out and have a higher density of points compared to region A.
